=== REFERENCES ===

Use the provided Riven, Riven's Broken Sword, Burning Settlement,
Mysterious Dark Figure, and TWO YEARS AGO FLASHBACK references.

Use the references for visual continuity throughout the video.

IMPORTANT:

The TWO YEARS AGO FLASHBACK reference is used ONLY for the brief memory sequence.

It represents an event from two years earlier:
Riven facing the mysterious dark figure through thick smoke.

Do not use the flashback environment or Riven's past appearance
for the present-day shots.

In the present, Riven carries Riven's Broken Sword.

The sword remains physically broken and dormant.

No glowing runes.
No magical energy.


=== TECHNICAL ===

16:9 cinematic live-action dark fantasy.

Grounded photorealistic realism.

Dark evening atmosphere.

Natural cinematic camera movement.

Clean cinematic cuts.

Natural firelight and heavy drifting smoke.

Natural footsteps, fire, wind, distant structural sounds,
and environmental ambience.

No subtitles.

No background music.

Keep the visual storytelling simple and clear.

The mysterious dark figure must remain partially obscured.

Do not fully reveal its face or detailed appearance.

No combat in this video.


=== VIDEO SUMMARY ===

Riven walks deeper into the burning settlement.

The road becomes quieter and almost empty.

She discovers a strange black mark on a damaged wooden structure.

The mark feels familiar.

Looking at it triggers a brief memory from two years ago:
Riven facing the mysterious dark figure through smoke.

The memory ends quickly.

Back in the present, Riven looks at her Broken Sword.

She realizes that what happened two years ago may be connected
to what is happening here now.

Then Riven notices something ahead.

Through the smoke at the far end of the road,
the same mysterious silhouette appears again.

Riven recognizes it.

Before she can approach, smoke passes across the road.

The silhouette is gone.


=== SHOTS ===

Shot 1 — THE MARK

Begin with Riven already walking deeper into the burning settlement.

Use a slow tracking shot slightly behind and beside her.

The crowded road is now almost empty.

Damaged wooden houses stand on both sides.

Fire burns in scattered areas.

Heavy smoke moves naturally between the buildings.

Riven continues forward carefully.

She carries the Broken Sword with her.

The sword remains inactive.

The distant voices gradually disappear.

The environment becomes strangely quiet.

Only fire, wind, footsteps, and damaged wood can be heard.

Riven looks around while walking.

Then something catches her attention.

She stops.

On a damaged wooden wall nearby is an unusual black mark.

Riven slowly approaches it.

Move closer with her.

The mark is extremely dark and irregular.

It looks different from ordinary soot or normal fire damage.

It does not glow.

It produces no visible energy.

Riven studies it carefully.

Her expression slowly changes.

She has seen something like this before.

Move into a close shot of Riven's eyes as the memory returns.


=== Shot 2 — TWO YEARS AGO ===

FLASH CUT.

Use the TWO YEARS AGO FLASHBACK reference for this moment.

The visual style immediately changes into a brief fragmented memory.

Thick smoke fills the frame.

Riven from two years ago stands in the foreground.

Farther ahead, partially hidden by the smoke,
is the mysterious dark figure.

Recreate the visual composition and atmosphere established by
the TWO YEARS AGO FLASHBACK reference.

The figure is only a dark silhouette.

Its form is difficult to understand.

No clear face.

No clear eyes.

No detailed reveal.

Orange firelight glows weakly through the smoke behind it.

Riven stares at the figure.

The figure remains almost completely still.

Hold only long enough for the memory to become recognizable.

Then—

HARD CUT BACK TO THE PRESENT.


=== Shot 3 — IT'S HERE ===

Riven is standing exactly where she was,
in front of the strange black mark.

The present-day burning settlement immediately returns.

Riven remains silent.

She slowly lowers her eyes.

Show the Broken Sword.

Riven looks at the damaged weapon for a brief moment.

The sword remains completely dormant.

No glow.

Riven now understands there may be a connection between
the event from two years ago and what is happening here.

A faint sound comes from farther down the road.

Riven immediately looks up.

She turns toward the sound.

Show her point of view.

The road ahead disappears into thick smoke.

Fire burns softly through the haze.

At first—

nothing.

Smoke slowly moves across the road.

Then a dark silhouette becomes visible far ahead.

The same mysterious figure.

It stands partially hidden inside the smoke.

Do not bring it close to Riven.

Keep distance between them.

Do not reveal its face.

Do not reveal detailed anatomy.

It should appear as an unnaturally dark humanoid silhouette
whose edges partially disappear into the surrounding smoke.

Cut back to Riven.

She freezes.

Recognition.

Her hand tightens around the Broken Sword.

She does not attack.

She does not speak.

Cut back toward the distant figure.

For a brief moment,
Riven and the mysterious figure face each other across the smoke-filled road.

Then a thick wave of smoke passes between them.

The figure becomes completely obscured.

The smoke clears.

The road is empty.

The figure is gone.

Riven stares at the empty space.

Hold on her reaction.

CUT.
